title: Training vs Tearlaments
summary: Tearlaments mills itself to fuse (Kitkallos, Rulkallos, Kaleido-Heart). Every mill can be a fusion opportunity. Interact on the mill/fusion that completes Kitkallos; do not feed them free GY setup.
winConditions: Banish names from GY so mills do not become fusions
Win before they loop fusions into a wall of disruption
keyCardsRespect: Tearlaments Reinoheart / Havnis / Merrli / Scheiren — mill engines
keyCardsNegate: The mill that enables fusion into Kitkallos
Field spell search if it finds the missing name

tips.title: Mills are not free
tips.body: Effects that make them mill can help them. Know when your 'disruption' is actually fuel.

tips.title: GY hate timing
tips.body: Banish a name before they fuse again; after Kitkallos resolves you are often behind.

tips.title: Board breakers
tips.body: They float and fuse from GY—play breakers when you can follow up, not as a one-shot hope.

handtrapGuidance: Ash Kitkallos or the search that finds the missing Tear name.
Imperm Kitkallos on summon when you must stop the mill/search.
Called by the Grave on a Tear name can freeze a fusion line for a turn.
commonMistakes: Milling them 'for value' and watching them fuse
